card.title: The One Normal Thing
card.instruction: Remain modest while controlling the single ordinary resource everyone needs to survive the increasingly impossible situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm just serving soup. This spoon's the last utensil that hasn't melted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're starving, and the soup's floating out of reach. Let me use it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll catch it for everyone. Send the smallest children first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's rising towards the ceiling. I'll lift you if you feed my daughter next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'm only the server; you're the legs. Carry me from child to child, and I'll portion what we catch.
